Preschool

          Preschool applicant should submit the following requirements to the Admission Office:

ENTRANCE Exam (Kinder only)

2 Photocopy of PSA Birth Certificate

3 pieces 2" x 2" recent colored ID Picture 

Copy of the Report Card with LRN (1 Original and  2 Photocopies) if the applicant undergone schooling

Baptismal Certificate/Certificate of Dedication (for non-Catholic)

Marriage Certificate (if parents are married)- OPTIONAL

2 pieces Long Folder

1 Long Brown Envelope

*All documents should be placed in a long brown envelope labeled with name written in pencil.




          For Nursery, the applicant should be at least 4 years old on or before October 31 of the current year.

          For Kindergarten, the applicant should be at least 5 years old on or before October 31 of the current year.

Senior High School

Senior High School applicant should submit the following requirements to the Admission Office:

ENTRANCE Exam

2 Photocopy of PSA Birth Certificate

3 pieces 2" x 2" recent colored ID Picture

Copy of the Report Card with LRN (1 Original and 2 Photocopies) duly signed by the school principal.

Recommendation Form (placed in a sealed envelope)

Certificate of Good Moral Character from the Guidance Counselor or School Principal.

Baptismal Certificate/Certificate of Dedication (for non-Catholic)

Marriage Certificate (if parents are married)- OPTIONAL

ESC Certificate from previous school for ESC Grantee only

NCAE Result for Grade 11 only (if available/applicable)

2 pieces Long Folder

1 Long Brown Envelope 

*All documents should be placed in a long brown envelope labeled with name written in pencil. 




             NOTE:  For STEM strand, Math and Science average must be 85% and above.

TLC Requirements

LIBRENG  de kaledad ba na Katolikong Edukasyon ang hanap mo?

Mag inquire na po sa STO. NIÑO CATHOLIC SCHOOL, INC.  dahil Taguig City Government ang siyang bahalang magbayad ng iyong Tuition Fees sa darating na SY2026-2027 sapagkat ang SNCS  ay TLC Participating school na mula noong school year 2021-2022.

Kaya naman kami ay tumatanggap na ng mga incoming Grade 7 students na galing sa PUBLIC SCHOOLS  at mga Grade 11 students nanggaling sa TLC Participating Schools o Private Schools na NON-SHS VOUCHER RECIPIENTS ng Taguig City. Ibig sabihin,  sila ay hindi sakop ng PEAC subsidy.
